maya: Heads-up: after merge r3456 we're seeing p99 tail latency +30% on int8 workloads during high-concurrency soak. CI perf run failed. Perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/perf/runs/4521 :eyes:
jon: Can you paste the perf job command and any logs?
maya: Command I ran: ```./tools/run_perf.sh --model=gpt-small --mode=int8 --concurrency=200 --duration=10m``` Logs/short flame: https://perf.redwood/fg/4521
lee: Noticed PR 445 (scheduler inflight limit changes) landed at same time as kernel selector tweak in r3456 (commit abc123). Kernel selector now prefers "prefetch-small" which seems to trigger the dequant path more often.
sophie: Flame graph shows dequant_stride and kv_cache_miss jumps at tokens ~4-8, and a hotter dequant_hotloop frame. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/fg-4521.png
ben: Scheduler change reduced max_inflight from 64 -> 32 to improve fairness. Under bursty loads that increases micro-batch churn and KV cache churn -> fallback dequant path gets hit more.
maya: Can someone bisect kernel selector vs scheduler? Repro is easy locally with high concurrency + short seq_len.
jon: Running git bisect now. Initial suspects: abc123 (kernel-pref) and PR445 (inflight). Will report back.
perf-bot: CI perf test 'int8-sustained' failed: baseline p99 28ms -> 36ms (+29%). Job: https://ci.redwood/job/4521 :warning:
jon: Bisect result: commit abc123 is the first bad commit. Kernel selector change increases dequant invocation frequency; PR445 amplifies the effect but isn't the root cause. Bisect log snippet: ```abc123 is first bad commit
commit abc123
Author: lee
Date: ...
    prefer prefetch-small for int8 workloads```
sophie: We should canary-hold the kernel selector change. I can prepare a revert CL (revert r3456) if ops agree — would avoid rolling forward more canaries.
lee: I have a revert ready: CL 789 (revert kernel-pref abc123). Submitting to canary queue now. Also proposing a temporary mitigation: bump max_inflight back to 64 and force kernel_override=int8_old_pref to reduce dequant hotpath hits.
maya: Mitigation config snippet (for canary hosts): ```runtime.scheduler.max_inflight=64
runtime.kernel.selector.force=int8_old_pref```
ben: Applied the inflight bump in local canary and forced the old kernel preference; p99 dropped back to ~29ms on the same workload. Re-ran with concurrency=200 for 5m.
maya: OK let's hold the rollout and block further canaries until revert lands. Opening incident INC-2026 and tagging infra-oncall. @lee please coordinate revert and canary gating. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: I'll re-run CI perf once the revert lands and canary is up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied to r3456 per request (reason: int8 p99 regression + dequant hotpath).
